Western Grebe Aechmophorus occidentalis with foot extended, Misson Bay, San Francisco, California.
The western grebe is the largest North American grebe. It is 55–75 cm (22–30 in) long, weighs 795–2,000 g (1.753–4.409 lb) and measures 79–102 cm (31–40 in) across the wings.
